orchestrator's mcp_agent.config.yaml registers git-mcp's LLM port but never its admin port/tools
checks.detail: # mcp-agent configuration for the phase 1 Orchestrator. | # Schema: https://github.com/lastmile-ai/mcp-agent/blob/main/src/mcp_agent/config.py | # | # Phase 1: one MCP server registered here - Workspace MCP. Chat MCP is | # reached directly by orchestrator/src/orchestrator/chat_client.py, not | # through this Agent-facing server list - see main.py's docstring and | # docs/adr/0001-phase-1-four-container-architecture.md. | # | # Phase 2 (docs/adr/0002-phase-2-isolation-ux-memory.md Decision 4) adds | # Memory MCP as a second Agent-facing server - a deliberate, scoped | # narrowing of ADR-0001 §2's "one tool" invariant, not a reversal of it: | # see that ADR section for why this one server is the accepted exception. | # | # Phase 3 (docs/adr/0003-phase-3-git-mcp.md Decision 3) adds Git MCP's | # LLM-facing port only (status/diff/log/branch_list/commit/create_branch/ | # checkout/push_request). Its admin port (push_execute/pending_push/ | # push_cancel) is deliberately NOT listed here - it's reached directly by | # orchestrator/src/orchestrator/git_admin_client.py, the same | # hand-rolled-client pattern chat_client.py already uses, so those three | # tools stay structurally unreachable by the LLM. | $schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lastmile-ai/mcp-agent/refs/heads/main/schema/mcp-agent.config.schema.json |  | name: bulkhead-orchestrator |  | execution_engine: asyncio |  | logger: |   transports: [console] |   level: info |  | mcp: |   servers: |     # Server key "workspace" + Workspace MCP's "exec" tool is namespaced by |     # mcp-agent as "workspace_exec" - the tool name implementation.md names. |     workspace: |       transport: streamable_http |       url: "http://workspace-mcp:8801/mcp" |     # Server key "memory" + its nine tools become "memory_create_entities", |     # "memory_search_nodes", etc. See ADR-0002 Decision 4 for the tool list |     # and the memory-store-poisoning risk it names. |     memory: |       transport: streamable_http |       url: "http://memory-mcp:8803/mcp" |     # Server key "git" + its eight tools become "git_status", "git_diff", |     # "git_push_request", etc. See ADR-0003 Decision 2/3 for the tool list |     # and why push_request only stages a request rather than pushing. |     git: |       transport: streamable_http |       url: "http://git-mcp:8805/mcp" |  | # API key goes in mcp_agent.secrets.yaml (gitignored) or the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY | # env var - see mcp_agent.secrets.yaml.example. | anthropic: |   default_model: claude-sonnet-5
